thread:
Alex: FYI got an escalated ticket — tenant 'tenant-rcx' lost ~2 hours of audit events in customer SIEM after a payment failure. Exports resumed after card update but customer reports missing window 2025-05-02T14:00Z -> 2025-05-02T16:00Z. Any ideas? cc @maria

billing-bot: Payment failed for tenant-rcx at 2025-05-02T13:58Z — auto-suspended exports per policy. Service resumed after manual retry at 2025-05-02T16:10Z :warning:

Alex: Can the suspension explain dropped events? They also saw KMS errors around 15:05 in our logs.

tao_infra: Looking. Export pipeline shows intermittent HSM decrypt errors 15:02-15:21: `DecryptError: HSM_UNAVAILABLE` in export-forwarder logs. Several batches moved to DLQ. Some S3 manifests for that window are zero-byte.

jess: Repro steps I ran: `aws s3 cp s3://audit-exports/tenant-rcx/20250502/15/*.gz .` then tried to decrypt with `openssl rsautl` and got `error:06065064: digital envelope routines:EVP_DecryptFinal_ex:wrong final block length` — consistent with a corrupted cipherblob.

maria_security: Could be two separate things: billing suspend paused the export planner so batches weren't scheduled; HSM errors mean some scheduled batches failed to encrypt before upload. Need sample event IDs and object keys to confirm whether events are missing entirely vs uploaded but corrupted.

Alex: Provided to the support ticket: event_ids [evt_AB12, evt_CD34], s3 keys `tenant-rcx/20250502/15/manifest-15-05.json.gz` and `shard-15-05-1.gz`.

export-bot: Found 3 failed batch entries for tenant-rcx between 2025-05-02T15:00Z and 15:24Z. DLQ path: `s3://export-dlq/tenant-rcx/20250502/15/`. Use `./tools/replay-export --tenant tenant-rcx --start 2025-05-02T15:00Z --end 2025-05-02T15:30Z` to requeue.

tao_infra: I checked HSM cluster: brief maintenance window at 15:03-15:09 where one HSM node failed to rejoin, causing >15% decrypt error rate; autoscale didn't kick due to capacity limit. Node came back at 15:10 but some batches had already failed and uploaded incomplete artifacts.

jess: I ran the replay locally on prod-backfill role, requeued 3 batches, they decrypted fine after re-encryption via KMS fallback. Customer confirmed 2/3 events now visible in SIEM, still missing evt_CD34. Manifest shows `actor_id` field null for that event — schema redaction rule applied? :thinking_face:

maria_security: We have a PII-redaction rule that strips `actor_id` when tenant opts-out of identity retention. Did the tenant change retention settings earlier? Cross-check audit settings.

Alex: Tenant confirmed they didn't change retention. Billing page shows they were on default retention. Could redaction have been applied because of export-suspend-to-disk fallback? Odd.

tao_infra: Possibility: during HSM outage we fell back to envelope encryption with KMS key rotation; if a field-level redaction job ran as part of export transformation and failed to attach metadata, `actor_id` may be suppressed. Will pull transformation logs.

jess: Transformation logs for that manifest: `transformation.apply: redaction: actor_id -> NULL (rule: remove_pii)` timestamp 2025-05-02T15:04:12Z — applied to batch id b-9832. That matches missing evt_CD34. Looks like redaction ran unexpectedly on that batch.

Alex: So root cause likely: payment suspension paused scheduling -> later when pipeline retried during HSM partial failure, transformation service ran with redaction toggled due to bad config reload. Action items?

maria_security: Action items: 1) Re-run replay for the DLQ batches with redaction disabled for tenant-rcx. 2) Audit config reloads around 15:00-15:10 and add guard to not apply redaction on replay. 3) Provide customer timeline and apology + confirm restored events. I'll own 2) and 3).

tao_infra: I'll open infra ticket to add HSM autoscale alert and failover policy. Also upload re-encrypted artifacts to replay path to avoid future decrypt errors.

jess: I'll run the replay now and confirm SIEM receipts. Command and expected ETA: `./tools/replay-export --tenant tenant-rcx --start 2025-05-02T15:00Z --end 2025-05-02T15:30Z --disable-redaction`

export-bot: Replay queued. ETA to completion ~6min. Will post status.

billing-bot: Billing note: tenant card updated at 2025-05-02T16:07Z; recommend we add a pre-suspend grace webhook to alert SRE on next payment failure.

Alex: Thanks everyone. I'll update customer and attach this thread. :thumbsup:

export-bot: Replay finished. 3 batches processed, 2 succeeded, 1 failed (b-9832). Failure reason: transformation validation error `rule-disabled` flagged but redaction state inconsistent. Jess to escalate to transformations team if not resolved.

jess: Escalating now to transformations. Pinged @lina. I'll follow up with customer once we have final state.
